purpose: Referência funcional pessoal e não punitiva herdada do AraLearn.
autonomy: learner pace/navigation/review marking; authored structure; explicit publish/apply
srl: microsequence objectives, structural status, review mark and situated comments; no inferred strategy
adaptation: none or human-authored static configuration; no automatic learner model
accessibility: structured resources and declared alternatives; baseline must be strengthened under WCAG/UDL research
ai: user-initiated MCP authoring, audit and repair; draft until validation and explicit application
data: minimal functional state; no attempts, errors, correctness, time or behavioral inference by default
offline: study and deterministic operations remain usable without live AI
authority: learner/author with explicit publication; accessibility and rights take precedence

purpose: Estudo pessoal com autonomia apoiada e autorregulação explícita.
autonomy: profile selection, pace, permitted sequence choices, review and AI assistance choices
srl: optional goals, planning, reflection, self-evaluation and help-seeking supports
adaptation: recommend-and-confirm based on declared preferences or valid responses; reversible
ai: on-demand explanations, hints, critique and planning; no answer substitution by default
data: private personal analytics only by opt-in; no institutional visibility
offline: static profile and prior materialized state remain available
authority: learner within authored dependencies and safety/accessibility constraints

purpose: Curso formal ou tutoria com estrutura autoral e escolhas relevantes do estudante.
autonomy: teacher defines goals/prerequisites; learner controls pace and bounded options
srl: teacher-authored strategy prompts, optional reflection and human support
adaptation: teacher/tutor recommendations; learner confirmation where permitted
accessibility: accommodations override ordinary course choices while construct is reviewed
ai: assistant for authoring, formative hints and tutor preparation; human approves
data: authorized formative evidence separated from grades and surveillance
offline: baseline course and learner state available; connected AI optional
authority: institution/teacher for formal policy, learner for permitted choices, accessibility precedence

autonomy: only controls declared by protocol; locks visible and consented
srl: prompts and supports are treatment components with versioned exposure
adaptation: protocol-defined, snapshotted and reversible only according to exception rules
accessibility: required accommodations documented at minimal necessary detail and comparability qualified
ai: model, context, prompt/profile, output status and review chain locked where possible
data: only protocol-authorized events/measures; withdrawal and retention rules explicit
offline: condition snapshot materialized; unavailable connected capability fails explicitly

purpose: Overlay transversal para remover barreiras e preservar participação.
autonomy: direct preference control with preview/reset; no forced diagnostic disclosure where avoidable
srl: supports available in alternative modalities and adjustable burden
adaptation: accessibility rule or learner preference may override ordinary configuration
accessibility: UDL-informed baseline, WCAG 2.2, AT compatibility, equivalence and construct qualification
ai: assistive functions allowed only with privacy, user control and non-AI fallback
data: sensitive accommodation rationale separated from applied settings
offline: authorized preferences and alternatives materialized locally
authority: rights/accessibility professional/learner over ordinary author or AI defaults

purpose: Construção iterativa de cursos/microssequências com GPT+MCP e ARA em tempo real.
autonomy: user directs by chat and deterministic ARA actions; selects scope, versions and application
srl: not a learner profile; author sees goals, plan, diffs, status and audit queue
adaptation: AI recommends composition/configuration changes; user previews and confirms
accessibility: authoring workflow includes accessible alternatives and audit obligations
ai: planner/builder → independent auditor → localized repair/re-audit; bounded context and contracts
data: authorized repository artifacts, comments and selected cross-course context; provenance retained
offline: ARA renders materialized drafts; live AI may be unavailable while deterministic inspection continues
authority: AI drafts/suggests; human author/reviewer approves and publishes

purpose: Assistência ao estudante durante estudo sem substituir esforço cognitivo.
autonomy: learner chooses when and which AI function to invoke
srl: prompts can request prediction, explanation or reflection before/after AI
adaptation: recommendation-only by default; no hidden learner model
accessibility: AI may offer modality/language assistance but cannot infer disability or remove human options
ai: bounded hints, explanations, questions and critique; output marked uncertain and contestable
data: minimal interaction retention; no use for grading or mastery without protocol
offline: course remains usable; AI capability unavailable explicitly
authority: learner; course/protocol may restrict answer-revealing functions

purpose: Implantação pessoal ou restrita sem dependência de modelo conectado.
autonomy: profile and course controls operate locally
srl: goals, notes, review and reflection implemented deterministically
adaptation: static profiles and explicit user choices only
accessibility: all baseline alternatives bundled; no cloud-only accommodation
ai: none at runtime; authored AI provenance may remain in artifacts
data: local functional state with optional synchronization

purpose: Autoria/ensino institucional com políticas, confidencialidade e revisão.
adaptation: only approved rules/models; audit, override and rollback required
accessibility: institutional duty plus individual rights; sensitive records role-limited
ai: approved providers/functions, human review tiers, provenance and incident handling
data: retention, access, pseudonymization and export governed
offline: profile-specific; confidential snapshots and revocation rules
authority: law/rights/consent > institutional policy > author/tutor > learner > AI
